title: Convex Bernstein limits and sharp recovery on expanding intervals
summary: We determine when approximation by convex polynomials on expanding intervals converges to best approximation on the real line by convex entire functions of exponential type at most $σ>0$. For intervals of radius $(n-γ_n)/σ$, where $0\leγ_n<n$ and $γ_n=o(n)$, one margin sequence gives this limit for every convex function of polynomial growth if and only if $γ_n/[n^{1/3}(\log n)^{2/3}]\to\infty$.
